e98f9a0a7615.title: Front-Office Data Support Analyst
e98f9a0a7615.description:
About 21shares 
 21shares is a crypto-native asset manager and the world's first, and one of its largest, issuers of physically-backed crypto ETPs. 21shares products are regulated under MiFID II and listed on leading exchanges across Europe and the UK, including the London Stock Exchange, SIX Swiss Exchange, Deutsche Boerse Xetra, Euronext Amsterdam and Paris, Borsa Italiana, and NASDAQ OMX. The firm operates under regulatory oversight from the Swedish FSA (EU prospectus), the FCA (UK), and FINMA (Switzerland). In the US, 21shares offers a range of exchange-traded products listed on Cboe and Nasdaq, including spot Bitcoin and spot Ethereum ETPs and a 21shares Active Crypto ETF - an actively managed fund providing diversified exposure across digital assets. 
 21shares has a track record in regulated ETP issuance, proprietary technology, and capital markets expertise that enables it to deliver transparent, cost-efficient investment solutions. 21shares is a subsidiary of FalconX, the leading digital asset prime brokerage for the world's top institutions.
 1. Basic Information & Requisition Details 
 Job Title: Front-Office Data Support Analyst
 Department: Capital Markets & Trading 
 Seniority / Level: Intern
 Employment Type: Internship - 12 months
 Location: London, UK 
 Target Start Date: ASAP 
 2. About the Role 
 Sit on the front-office trading desk at the centre of 21shares' ETF/ETP business, with direct, ongoing exposure to how the firm's data, products, and market activity connect
 Work across three lenses on the desk's data: research (sourcing and structuring), reconciliation (validating accuracy against source systems), and performance (tracking and reporting on product and market activity), building and maintaining the underlying infrastructure via API and internal databases
 Independently identify gaps in data coverage or reporting and take ownership of resolving them, rather than working purely to a fixed task list
 Partner directly with product, research, and legal teams, translating data into outputs used both internally and externally
 Gain in-depth knowledge in crypto , trading, research, operations and lifecycle of an asset manager in addition to deep knowledge on data analytics
 3. Key Responsibilities 
 Data maintenance: Maintain and validate daily data feeds (NAV, AUM, flows, holdings, staking rewards, index values etc) across the internal database and third-party APIs, flagging discrepancies before they start affecting the product's health
 Cross-functional collaboration: Serve as the link between the trading desk and the data/engineering team, translating desk requirements into technical specs and communicating data/system constraints back to trading and product stakeholders
 Process automation: Identify manual or spreadsheet-based reporting workflows and replace them with Python/SQL scripts/Claude dashboards to reduce turnaround time and error rate as well as document the process.
 External data validation: Support QA of data published to external channels (website, product pages, factsheets) to ensure consistency with the internal source of truth
 Ad hoc requests: Handle ad hoc data requests from product development, risk, distribution teams etc
 4. Qualifications & Skills 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor or Master’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field
 Strong experience coding in Python and SQL within a collaborative development environment (work, team projects, open-source etc)
 Genuine interest in financial markets and curiosity to learn more on risk management, market dynamics, blockchain and DeFi  concepts
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills
 Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration skills
 Disciplined self-starter with a high degree of rigor and attention to detail
 You like to challenge and be challenged to get the best solutions to a problem
 Preferred Qualifications / Nice-to-Haves 
 Familiarity with financial products like ETPs and ETFs
 Experience working directly with technical and development teams
 Working knowledge of database systems (PostgreSQL or similar)
 5. Candidate Criteria & Ideal Profile 
 Target Experience Level: Entry-level / Internship (prior data experience preferred)
 Target Industries / Companies: Crypto, Asset Management, Fintech
 Salary: £ 27,000.00/year

3ef986d6547b.title: Junior Executive Assistant
3ef986d6547b.description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 
 How we started: 
 Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.
 Where we are now: 
 We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.
 In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.
 Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.
 Where we’re going: 
 2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.
 There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality! 
 The Opportunity
 As Junior Executive Assistant, you’ll work at the heart of HeliosX, supporting three to four members of our Executive Leadership Team across diaries, travel, events and day-to-day coordination. You’ll be the second person in our EA function and will be mentored by an EA who joined HeliosX without a traditional EA background, built the function from scratch and now supports five executives. You don’t need previous EA or PA experience. We’re hiring for attitude, judgement and potential - the practical side of the role can be taught. HeliosX moves quickly and priorities change often. From your first week, you’ll work directly with senior leaders, gain exposure to how the business operates and take on more responsibility as the EA function grows. This is a full-time, permanent role with a hybrid working arrangement based at our London HQ.
 What you’ll do
 Manage diaries for three to four members of the Executive Leadership Team, resolving conflicts and adapting quickly as priorities change.
 Protect leaders’ time, making sure meetings have the right purpose, people and information.
 Arrange domestic and international travel, including complex itineraries and last-minute changes.
 Coordinate meetings, offsites and company events, managing venues, suppliers, catering and logistics.
 Support with inbox management, meeting actions and follow-ups.
 Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
 Manage confidential documents, expenses, purchase orders, contract renewals and other day-to-day administration.
 Build strong relationships across the business to help things move quickly and smoothly.
 What you’ll bring
 You don’t need to have been an EA before. We’re looking for evidence that people trust and rely on you - whether that comes from hospitality, retail, customer service, events, office support, healthcare, university, sport or another fast-paced environment.
 Experience organising something end to end, with multiple people, moving parts and a deadline.
 Strong organisation and follow through - you keep track of details and make sure things get done.
 Emotional intelligence - you read people well and adapt your approach.
 Proactivity and ownership - you spot what needs doing rather than waiting to be asked.
 Composure - when priorities change, you re-plan and keep moving.
 Good judgement and discretion, particularly when handling confidential or sensitive information.
 Clear, confident written and verbal communication.
 Confidence using Google Workspace, or evidence that you pick up new tools quickly.
 Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, or an interest in learning to use them well.
 At HeliosX, we want to improve healthcare for everyone, and to do this we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition. We are currently a diverse team of engineers, scientists, clinical researchers, physicians, pharmacists, marketeers, and customer care specialists committed to our mission - but we need more talented folks to join us if we want to achieve our global ambitions!
Aside from working with our all-star team, here are some of the other benefits you may be eligible for coming on board: 
 Generous equity allocations with significant upside potential
 Annual leave allowance alongside public holidays
 Private health insurance, along with pre-existing condition, dental, and eye care cover
 Pension scheme
 Enhanced parental leave
 Cycle-to-work scheme
 Electric car scheme
 Free Dermatica and MedExpress products every month, as well as family discounts
 Annual home working and L&D allowance
 Free Headspace subscription, employee assistance programme, and discounted gym memberships

Junior Growth Manager 
 As a Junior Growth Manager you’ll play a key role in driving the next phase of growth for the Partnerships channel within the HelloFresh Group. If you are a keen negotiator, analytical, have a strong foundation in data and measurement, and drive big ideas, you will thrive in this role. You will support the expansion of our acquisition ecosystem by sourcing, developing, and managing high‑impact and commercially strategic partnerships across the UK for both HelloFresh and Green Chef. In this role, you will focus on identifying new opportunities, building a strong pipeline of potential partners, and managing end-to-end campaigns. You will nurture and grow existing relationships while proactively securing new partners, defining the global standard. You’ll collaborate closely with local and global Growth Partnerships teams, bringing an innovative, commercial mindset to the channel. 
 To succeed, you’ll bring hands‑on experience in partnerships, strong relationship‑building skills, and a passion for business development that fuels long‑term, sustainable growth.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Build and maintain a strong roadmap of new, high‑quality partnership opportunities across varied industries and verticals (Content/Editorial, Card Linked Offers, B2B, Gift Cards, and more), targeting high brand-affinity, high-intent and reach.
 Prospecting, pitching, and securing new acquisition‑focused partnerships.
 Manage the housing and optimisation of partner offers to deliver partner value and grow platform reach.
 Manage and scale the B2B sub‑channel (Daily Deals, Gift Cards).
 Measurement & analysis against partnerships with a reactive and commercially strategic mindset, negotiating on cost mechanics and pivoting when needed.
 Share insights, learnings, and best practices with wider local and international markets to enhance global performance, along with adopting global learnings for local success. 
 Who You Are 
 Ideally you have a background in growth marketing, consulting, or data handling. 
 Growth mindset: commercially strategic with a strong foundation in measurement (COS/ROI, CAC, LTV are essential, CVA/CCV is desired), efficiency, incrementality and negotiation. 
 Ideas-led with the ability to think big and think “brand” - expanding partnership proposals holistically to leverage relevant marketing channels where it adds value. 
 A natural relationship builder – strong people skills, confident communicator, and able to influence internal and external stakeholders.
 Ability to evaluate performance, spot data trends, and ideate and execute regular A/B tests. 
 Organised, independent, and adaptable with solid project management skills – able to manage multiple conversations, priorities, and deadlines.
 A problem solver who quickly identifies barriers and drives solutions.
 A collaborative team player who contributes to a positive culture and works seamlessly across teams to achieve shared goals.
 Excited by growth, and passionate about building scalable partnerships that deliver long‑term impact and value.
 What you will get in return: 
 ● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Nursery support scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance
 Location : The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London
 Hybrid Working Policy

 To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time. 
 You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. c65dd95862c6.description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Works in Progress is Stripe's magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture, published online and in print. We have a fast-growing global audience, primarily in tech, finance and politics, and we are building out the team across editorial, design, operations and commercial.
 What you’ll do 
 This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.
 You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.
 You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.
 Responsibilities 
 Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
 Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
 Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
 Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
 Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
 Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
 Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
 Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
 Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
 Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
 Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
 Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
 Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
 Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
 Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.
 Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets.
 Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations.
 Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know.
 Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly.
 Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
 Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.

ac67da1a2100.title: Payroll Analyst - International
ac67da1a2100.location: London, United Kingdom London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo
ac67da1a2100.description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About Deliveroo 
 At Deliveroo, our mission is to build the definitive food company. To make that possible, we’re creating an environment where everyone can belong, grow, and do their best work.
 About the Role 
 As an Italy Payroll Analyst , you will be responsible for administering and overseeing the end-to-end payroll process for our Italy population. You’ll partner closely with HR, Finance, Employment Tax, Legal and our external payroll providers to ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll delivery.
 This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise in Italian payroll legislation, statutory compliance and employee taxation . You will act as the Italy Payroll Subject Matter Expert (SME) , ensuring robust payroll governance, maintaining high standards of accuracy and supporting continuous improvement across our Workday and CloudPay payroll ecosystem.
 You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities to simplify, automate and improve payroll processes, while supporting wider global payroll initiatives and projects.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Lead the end-to-end Italy payroll process — from data preparation, validation and payroll inputs through to review, reconciliation and final sign-off, ensuring accurate and timely payroll delivery.
 Act as the Italy Payroll SME , providing expert guidance on Italian payroll legislation, taxation, statutory requirements and payroll best practice.
 Support other payroll entities within the team where required, contributing to the successful delivery of the wider global payroll operation.
 Oversee outsourced payroll processing with our payroll provider, CloudPay, ensuring agreed SLAs, controls and quality standards are consistently met.
 Partner cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Employment Tax and Legal to resolve payroll issues, ensure accurate data flows and deliver a seamless employee payroll experience.
 Maintain strong knowledge of Italian payroll legislation and statutory requirements , ensuring payroll processes remain compliant with regulatory changes.
 Ensure the accurate and timely processing of Italian statutory payments, contributions and filings , including social security, income tax and other applicable statutory requirements.
 Review and reconcile payroll outputs , identifying discrepancies and ensuring issues are investigated and resolved before payroll sign-off.
 Prepare and reconcile payroll journals and Finance reporting , ensuring payroll costs are accurately reflected in financial records and supporting audit requirements.
 Manage payroll controls and governance , ensuring appropriate checks are completed throughout each payroll cycle and maintaining a strong audit trail.
 Drive continuous improvement and automation , identifying opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve controls and increase payroll efficiency.
 Act as SME for CloudPay and Workday payroll processes in Italy , supporting system enhancements, integrations, testing and payroll-related projects.
 Support Workday and payroll implementation/migration projects , including requirements gathering, testing, parallel runs and go-live activities.
 Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders , proactively identifying risks and resolving payroll issues.
 Share knowledge and best practice with colleagues across the wider Payroll team, supporting a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.
 Support regional and global payroll initiatives , ensuring Italy remains aligned with Deliveroo’s wider payroll strategy and operating model.
 Requirements 
 3+ years of progressive payroll experience , including significant experience managing Italian payroll and statutory compliance.
 Strong technical knowledge of Italian payroll legislation, employment taxation, social security and statutory requirements .
 Experience managing or overseeing outsourced payroll providers , ideally within a multinational or international organisation.
 Experience with Workday and/or CloudPay is preferred but not essential.
 Proven ability to manage the full payroll lifecycle , including payroll inputs, validation, reconciliation, sign-off and statutory reporting.
 Strong understanding of payroll controls, governance, audit requirements and data integrity.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across HR, Finance, Tax, Legal and external vendors.
 Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies .
 Experience supporting payroll system implementations, integrations, testing or transformation projects is desirable.
 Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to perform detailed payroll reconciliations, analyse large datasets and identify discrepancies.
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables and confidently challenge processes or data where required.
 Fluent Italian and strong English communication skills are highly desirable.
 Why Deliveroo? 
 We’re a technology-driven company transforming how the world eats — making food more accessible, faster and better. At Deliveroo, you’ll join a collaborative and dynamic environment where innovation, ownership and agility are valued.
 We also believe that great workplaces celebrate diversity and inclusivity. We welcome every background, perspective and passion — especially if you share our love for food and excellence.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

67592698fc36.title: Strategic Project Intern
67592698fc36.description:
Strategic Project Intern 
 Start Date: January 2027
 Location: London
 About Wonder Studios 
 Wonder Studios is an AI-native film and content studio building an entertainment business for the AI era. Founded by award-winning filmmaker and creative technologist Justin Hackney and marketplace entrepreneur Xavier Collins, Wonder works across original IP,  commercial productions and filmmaker development.
 Wonder brings together a studio, talent marketplace and global community of creative and AI-native filmmakers, pairing creatives and engineers from the start of each project to support ambitious storytelling and new production models. 
 We’ve raised more than $15 million from elite investors including LocalGlobe, Atomico and Adobe as well as angels from the leading AI companies including OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google DeepMind. 
 We’re now a team of 35+ based around the world with offices in London, LA, NYC and SF.
 For more information, visit www.wonderstudios.com  
 The Role 
 You will join the Strategy and Growth Manager and work directly with Wonder's executive team on the projects that matter most to the company right now. You will not shadow anyone. You will own each mission, from the first question to the final result.
 You will build a full picture of how Wonder works, and you will grow your analysis, project management and communication skills along the way. Depending on your strengths, your interests and what the business needs, you may support one or several core teams. As you prove yourself, you will take on more responsibility, with guidance from experienced colleagues.
 You will own real projects that grow Wonder's audience, content output and revenue, and keep the business running efficiently. This is not a note-taking job. You will research, build, test and present, and your work will change what the team does next.
 The internship lasts 6 months. It is full-time and based in London. Start date January 2027.
 What you'll do 
 Growth 
 Study the full funnel of the Wonder community, across both organic and paid channels, and find where people join, stay or drop off.
 Run experiments from the top of the funnel to the bottom, and measure what each one changes. Carry out your own recommendations. You do not hand them to someone else.
 Own the day-to-day running of Wonder's social channels, and build the systems around them, such as content calendars, posting workflows and performance tracking, so the work keeps running without effort.
 Explore ways to fill the top of the revenue funnel, such as partner marketing, outbound, strategic partnerships and SEO.
 Report every week on what worked, what did not, and what you will change next.
 Business operations 
 Wonder is a vertically-integrated studio. Work with your manager to leverage AI at each step of the value chain of a next-generation film and commercial production studio.
 Revenue 
 Support new business for our Agency and IP arms: build target lists, research accounts and prepare pitch materials.
 Keep the pipeline clean and up to date in our CRM.
 Analyze deals, pricing and margins, and show leadership where to focus.
 What You'll Bring 
 A bachelor's degree from a top university.
 One or two internships in high-intensity settings, such as consulting, VC, start-ups or finance.
 A record of exceptional results that you can point to.
 Sharp thinking. You break complex problems down from first principles. You catch the details that matter, work against your own biases, and explain hard things in a few clear sentences.
 Social media. You are at ease running experiments on social channels and being the face on camera. 
 Ownership. You drive outcomes. You do not wait for instructions. When something breaks, you fix it.
 Simplicity. You pick the simplest answer that works and ship it. Done and useful beats perfect and late.
 Drive. You are ambitious, and your effort matches it. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising. You see this internship as the fastest way to learn, and you are ready to work for it.
 Team spirit. You give freely and back the best idea, not your own. You are reliable and honest, and you help the team even when the work is not glamorous.
 Hunger. You see this internship as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.
 Why Wonder 
 Work at the forefront of AI-native filmmaking, marketing award-winning content that is genuinely changing how stories get made and who gets to make them
 Gain unique exposure across the worlds of film, technology and AI, working alongside partners including Google DeepMind, Universal Music Group and Adobe
 Join at the moment it matters: $15M raised, $1M+ revenue in year one, on target to hit $10M this year, and the most exciting part of building still ahead

b26f05667b14.description:
Practice Group / Department: 
 Knowledge Practice Management - London Job Description 
 Norton Rose Fulbright is a global law firm with more than 3,000 lawyers advising clients across locations in the United States, Europe, Canada, Latin America, Asia, Australia, Africa and the Middle East. We provide a full scope of legal services to the world’s preeminent corporations and financial institutions.
 Our vision is to be a world class business, profitable, ambitious, cooperative and considerate, supporting our clients and people through our global business principles of Quality, Unity and Integrity.
 With over 7,000 employees worldwide, our culture is the thread that connects us. Our strategy and culture are closed connected – defined by shared ambition, global collaboration and a one-team mindset. We believe pioneering work happens when people are empowered to think beyond boundaries, explore new opportunities and grow through diverse experiences. Alongside the right skills and experience, we are looking for people who are innovative, commercially minded, and motivated by the impact of the work they do – ready to share in our ambition and help shape what comes next.
 Because while individuals can do well, together we achieve something extraordinary.
 Our London office is recruiting a Junior Knowledge Executive. We are looking for someone with relevant skills and experience who is innovative, commercially aware and takes pride in their work. 
 The Team 
 Knowledge plays an important strategic role at Norton Rose Fulbright. The team helps colleagues deliver high-quality legal services by developing legal templates and guidance, sharing expert insight and using technology to improve legal practice.
 The Junior Knowledge Executive will support the London Knowledge team, which works with colleagues and clients across EMEA. The role combines knowledge administration, training coordination and support for the team’s internal and client-facing resources.
 The role 
 The Junior Knowledge Executive will provide professional administrative support to the Knowledge team. Key responsibilities include:
 Amending legal templates, guidance notes and marketing materials, including bids and briefings, accurately and in line with the firm’s house style
 Loading and managing knowledge content in the firm’s internal knowledge database (Insight+)
 Updating knowledge intranet pages in Microsoft SharePoint or a similar web page editing platform
 Arranging travel for knowledge team members in liaison with the firm’s travel agency where required (itineraries, transport, accommodation, currency and processing expenses, etc.)
 Diary management including co-ordination and recording of knowledge team annual leave and other absences
 Using key software confidently, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Zoom and Microsoft Teams, and completing training where needed
 Coordinating in-person and virtual training across EMEA for colleagues and clients. This includes booking rooms, arranging audiovisual support, catering and printing, setting up events, managing registrations, sending reminders and working with other support teams.
 Assisting knowledge team members with the preparation of training materials and PowerPoint slides
 Editing recorded training and uploading courses to the firm’s learning management system
 Coordinating the external training course application process, including payment of invoices and managing central records
 Professional skills and approach: 
 Clarify instructions promptly where requirements or deadlines are unclear, and plan competing priorities to meet deadlines
 Support colleagues, provide cover and contribute to shared team priorities when needed
 Handle confidential client and team matters with tact, diplomacy and professionalism
 Show an active interest in the team’s work, respond constructively to queries and identify practical solutions
 Build effective working relationships with colleagues across the Knowledge team and EMEA offices
 Take a positive and committed approach, including providing support outside core hours and working arrangements when required
 undefined
 Skills and experience required: 
 English Language GCSE or equivalent
 Secretarial or administrative qualifications/ILEX secretarial certificate/diploma qualification desirable but not essential
 Confident and professional, with sound judgement and the ability to work independently when appropriate
 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across different teams and locations
 Keen to learn and broaden experience and responsibilities

77c3f3b3389e.description:
We are looking for inquisitive problem solvers to join us for our Summer Internship. 
 At Mako, we believe in the power of collaboration to drive innovation in pursuit of our collective ambition, excellence in trading. Our diverse community is connected through a commitment to being the best we can be with the highest standards of integrity. 
 A unique internship for curious minds .
 Mako’s Summer Internship is a comprehensive program aimed at developing industry knowledge and practical experience in options markets. As trading increasingly relies on automation and data-driven strategies, the collaboration between our software engineering and trading teams has become more integrated and dynamic.
 Our tailored, holistic program spans for four weeks and provides an in-depth overview of the markets in which Mako operates. It covers fundamental options theory, risk management and the technology utilised throughout the business. This gives you an insight into what we do and how we work, while also equipping you with valuable skills to take back to university for your final year and beyond.
 During the internship, you will have the opportunity to work with highly experienced traders to understand the options and wider financial industry in greater depth. This will also cover other areas such as:
 Market dynamics, trading strategies, and financial analysis.
 Lectures, Q&A sessions with trading specialists, and mock trading.
 Simulation of real-world trading, analysing market trends, and developing strategies.
 Concluding with a trading-related assignment, evaluated by experts with personalised feedback.
 Exploring cutting-edge technology driving financial markets.
 Feature lectures and Q&A sessions with Mako’s tech experts, along with directed learning.
 What we need from you 
 Currently enrolled in the 2nd or final year of a STEM-related degree program
 Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyse and resolve complex challenges
 Demonstrates a positive attitude and a strong passion for continuous learning and development
 Exceptional mathematical aptitude with a proven track record of high-level quantitative skills
 Proficient in programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
 The Mako internship is challenging, rewarding and fun in equal measure and designed to provide you with skills that will set you up for success, whatever you choose to do beyond this summer.
 About Mako 
 Mako is a leading options market maker with a global trading footprint. It has been at the forefront of options market making since 1999, from the open outcry trading pits to screen trading and automated algorithmic execution strategies that are driving the future of the industry.
 From offices in London, Dublin, Amsterdam, Singapore, Sydney, Brisbane and Chengdu, Mako offers the best in class liquidity solutions across Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities and FX derivatives markets and prides itself in its entrepreneurial, collaborative and philanthropic culture.
 For further information on the Mako Group please refer to our website: www.mako.com .
 If you require any support or adjustments with the application process or have any questions about the application process, please contact recruitment@mako.com

0cbd5e749523.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
0cbd5e749523.description:
The Role 
 We are looking for an ambitious and proactive Accounts Payable Assistant to join our team in London. This is a great opportunity for someone in the early stages of their finance career who is keen to build their experience in a fast-paced, international environment and take on increasing responsibility as they develop.
 The role will primarily support the Financial Advisory business, while providing support across other geographies when required. You will work closely with colleagues across the finance function, giving you exposure to different teams, processes and systems and the opportunity to develop a broad understanding of how finance operates within an international business.
 You will be joining a supportive team where you will receive training on our internal processes and systems. We offer excellent hybrid working flexibility , with a minimum of two days per week in our London office , where you can enjoy our modern City workspace, on-site gym, barista coffee, complimentary snacks and drinks, and a brilliant social calendar .
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support the day-to-day Accounts Payable function for the Financial Advisory business.
 Process and manage invoices and AP transactions, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
 Support payments, reconciliations and invoice query resolution.
 Work across multiple finance systems and platforms, quickly building confidence in internal processes.
 Use Excel to review, reconcile and analyse financial data.
 Collaborate with finance colleagues in London and internationally, providing cross-geography support when needed.
 Take ownership of deadlines and deliverables, helping to keep finance processes running smoothly.
 Skills & Experience 
 Ideally 1–2 years’ finance experience, with exposure to Accounts Payable.
 Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and PivotTables.
 A good understanding of finance and accounting principles, with the ability to hit the ground running and learn quickly.
 Working towards a professional qualification such as ACCA, CIMA or AAT, or a degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, would be advantageous.
 Experience using finance or accounting systems; NetSuite experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
 A collaborative and flexible team player, comfortable working across teams and geographies.
 About Teneo   
 Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future. Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organizations.
 Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial trans­ac­tions and restruc­tur­ing, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, orga­ni­za­tion­al design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG. The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

40737d324818.title: Summer 2027 - Risk Internship
40737d324818.description:
We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.   
 Capstone is a global, alternative investment management firm operating across a broad range of derivatives-based strategies with a deep understanding of volatility. With approximately $14.6 billion of AUM and 315 employees (as of September 1, 2026, Capstone was formed in 2007 and is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Tokyo, California, Stamford, Boston, and Milan.    
 At Capstone, we constantly aim to expand our view of how WE SEE THE WORLD DIFFERENTLY® in order to create opportunity. Our commitment to provoking the evolution of asset management provides us with a perpetual hunger for knowledge that we believe drives the improvement of our particular approach to investment. We seek to harness the complexities of global derivatives markets with disciplined strategic insight, an experienced, accomplished team and advanced technology to create sustainable value. We’ve created a particular approach to investment that we believe drives continuous improvement and opportunities for our clients, team and industry.   
 Overview:   
 The Risk Management Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and managing the risks of the firm. The team identifies, quantifies, evaluates, and reports the risks which result from trading strategies across all asset classes. It works closely with trading and technology teams to create and maintain tools for risk management and analytics, to make managers aware of existing and potential risks to the firm and its investors. 
 Our future colleague has these skills:   
 Current enrollment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 Proficiency in Python and/or Java, including the ability to apply programming skills to data analysis, quantitative problem-solving, or similar technical work. 
 Familiarity with machine learning is required.
 Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to contribute effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues. 
 A professional, accountable approach to work and an ability to collaborate in a manner consistent with the firm’s culture and values.   
 Do you possess these Bonus Skills:   
 Prior internship, academic, or professional experience within financial services, investment management, or a related field is preferred. 
 Intellectual curiosity, the openness to share ideas, humility, the highest ethical standards and a desire to excel are a few of the traits that it takes to thrive and be your best self at Capstone. 
 To thrive at Capstone, a keen curiosity about technology and artificial intelligence is essential, as we continually drive innovation and enhance our strategic capabilities.    
 Benefits and Compensation Information:    
 Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this.    
 The hourly pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.    
 Equal Opportunity Employer:    
 Capstone is committed to creating an inclusive environment where we welcome people of different backgrounds. Capstone considers applications for employment without regard to all applicable protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, parental status, veteran status, or disability status.   
 To learn even more about being part of the team, visit us online:  Careers - Capstone (capstoneco.com)   
 Don’t forget to follow us on LinkedIn

 Location & Travel

 This role is home-based, with regular travel required to the office in East London/South Essex. Travel also required to retailer meetings, Agency and third-party supplier meetings as required.

This is a remote position but you must be flexible to attend meetings in the office and with clients when required; therefore being a car driver is essential for this role.

 * Driving further development of shopper and e-commerce initiatives.

 * Delivering market-leading shopper campaigns.

* Deliver best-in-class online and mobile optimisation, adhering to platform guidelines and maintaining content through platforms such as Brandbank.
* Analyse shopper and .com campaigns, gathering insights and learning's to inform future planning.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retailer media contacts and key stakeholders.
* Identify and implement cross-category collaborations and drive brand visibility during key events.
* Work closely with agencies and third-party suppliers on shopper-focused campaigns, content creation, and delivery.
* Track competitor activity and market trends to inform strategy.
* Build an external network to bring fresh insights and ideas into the business
 What We're Looking For: 
 FMCG, Retail or fast-paced marketing environment experience (Min 1-2 years)
 Marketing degree or equivalent experience 
 Passion for in-store marketing and POS materials
 Strong communication skills and attention to detail
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365

61de853ae513.description:
The Role 
 We are seeking two dedicated and motivated Careers & Work Experience (WEX) Coordinators to join our Student Experience department at Hammersmith Campus.
 *PLEASE NOTE THIS POST IS TERM TIME ONLY & FIXED TERM UNTIL JULY 2027* 
 The successful candidates will play a key role in supporting learners to develop their employability, career readiness, independence and preparation for adulthood. Working closely with curriculum teams, employers, learners, parents/carers and external agencies, you will coordinate meaningful work experience opportunities, employer engagement activities, careers education and progression pathways.
 You will be responsible for developing strong relationships with employers and partners to increase opportunities for learners across a range of sectors, including work experience placements, industry placements, internships, apprenticeships, supported internships and employment.
 The role will have a particular focus on ensuring that careers and work experience opportunities are inclusive, accessible and responsive to the needs of all learners , including those with SEND, EHCPs and other additional support needs.
 The ideal candidate will: 
 Develop and maintain strong relationships with local, regional and national employers to create meaningful careers, work experience and progression opportunities for learners.
 Source, coordinate and monitor high-quality work experience, industry placements, internships and employment opportunities across curriculum areas, including opportunities for T-level learners.
 Match learners to appropriate work experience placements based on their career aspirations, skills, interests, support needs and level of independence.
 Complete appropriate placement suitability checks, risk assessments and monitoring arrangements to ensure safe and successful work experience.
 Work closely with curriculum teams, support staff, employers and external agencies to ensure learners are well prepared for and supported throughout their work experience.
 Monitor learner engagement, progress and outcomes during placements and evaluate the impact of work experience opportunities.
 Deliver careers education, employability workshops and activities that support learners to understand different career pathways and employment opportunities.
 Support learners to develop key employability skills, including CV writing, completing application forms, interview techniques, workplace behaviours and professional communication.
 Coordinate employer presentations, guest speakers, careers fairs, industry insight days and sector-specific engagement activities.
 Promote a wide range of progression opportunities, including employment, apprenticeships, supported internships, higher education and further learning.
 Support learners to understand the qualifications, skills and experience required to achieve their career aspirations and develop appropriate progression plans where required.
 Work collaboratively with Transition Coordinators, SEND teams and Employment Pathway Coordinators to support learners with additional needs.
 Ensure careers education, employer engagement and work experience opportunities are inclusive and accessible, identifying and supporting reasonable adjustments where required.
 Promote supported internships, supported employment and preparation for adulthood pathways for learners with SEND and additional support needs.
 Provide individual support to learners, including those with SEND and EHCPs, care experienced young people, young carers, learners from disadvantaged backgrounds and learners at risk of becoming NEET.
 Safeguarding of Children and Vulnerable Adults 
 In line with Keeping Children Safe in Education All employment offers are subject employment checks. These include (some of which are dependent on the role and the individual): Enhanced DBS including Children’s Barred List check, DfE teaching/management Barred List check, on-line searches, overseas criminal record check, evidence of identity and Right to Work in the UK, satisfactory references, confirmation of medical fitness, evidence of relevant qualifications and a check of previous employment history.
 The College is committed to safeguarding and promotes the welfare of all learners and expects its staff to share this commitment. You will be required to become familiar with the College's policies, and comply with the requirements to safeguard and protect the welfare of children and young people and vulnerable adults. All staff are asked to complete mandatory training in relation to KCSIE and other key areas, and to read the relevant policies.
 Equality, Diversity and Inclusion 
 The College has a strong commitment to working towards the implementation of equality of opportunity in both service delivery and employment. The College’s mission and strategic objectives directly support this aim. All employees are required to actively support the development, dissemination and implementation of this aim and related policies and programmes.
 Recruitment Process 
 The email account you use to apply will be used for all recruitment communication. Please ensure that you use an email account that you regularly monitor.
 All application forms must be fully completed, including a full record of education and employment history. Incomplete applications will not be considered for shortlisting.
 The salary for this position is inclusive of London weighting. Please note that we advertise our salaries on a range to indicate the trajectory of progression that can be made. Appointments are usually made at the start of the salary range.
 We may close this vacancy early if we receive enough applications, so we encourage you to submit yours promptly. If you don’t hear from us within 2–3 weeks after the closing date, please know that, unfortunately, you have not been shortlisted this time. We truly appreciate your interest and hope you’ll consider applying for future opportunities with us. 
 **Please note that we do not accept CVs**

ac8786298ad6.title: One Year Internship - Supply, Trading & Shipping - UK
ac8786298ad6.description:
Entity: 
 Supply, Trading & Shipping 
 Job Family Group: 
 Business Support Group, Supply & Trading Group 
 Job Description: 
 About bp 
 bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition.
 Our internships 
 Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp.
 Our one year internship programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You'll be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There’ll be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training and grow your network across the business.
 Role and responsibilities 
 The internship programme is designed to give you maximum exposure to our supply, trading & shipping (ST&S) business. You will be working on projects with real impact to our business. You’ll be placed in a team with opportunities to showcase and enhance your skillset, follow your ambition and be part of the team’s success.                                                               
 Examples of previous projects include:  
 Carrying out research and analysis into a particular market or new jurisdiction and producing a strategy to help support trading decisions and growth.   
 Producing daily news/customer information reports to highlight market information and opportunities for trading and origination.  
 Analytics in support of our fundamental and demand supply view for short/medium term revenue activity.   
 Working to automate and optimise systems, reports, and analysis to speed up trading processes and decisions using various data science techniques.  
 Throughout, you will have on the job training as well as industry-leading learning to develop technical and soft skills. Alongside this, a graduate buddy will help you network and learn everything you need to perform in the organisation. During the internship programme you will be assessed for your suitability for the ST&S development programme. You will have the opportunity to learn about the development tracks through networking, training & information sessions before deciding on whether you would like to be considered, and if so, which development track you'd like to apply to.   
 Supply, Trading & shipping development track career pathway    
 Commercial track   
 Every year, bp invests billions of dollars searching for new sources of energy, supplying our customers with the fuels they need. You’ll help to ensure we make the best use of our investment for bp and for our customers. We want you to be in the best position to propose new and creative ways to maximize value.  This could see you working in our Marketing & deal Origination teams or in physical operations or other areas which support trading ideas and deals.  The commercial track will help you to develop strong commercial acumen which is supported by the different rotations you will undertake.   
 Trading track   
 You’ll be part of the teams managing our trades on all the major energy commodity exchanges as well as our daily exposure to global currency and interest rate fluctuations. You’ll have the opportunity to experience different trading disciplines and styles from physical trading to paper trading, even the possibility to specialise in quantitative trading. Over the course of the 3-year programme you’ll complete rotations that are designed to give you the opportunity to build your skills and knowledge in a trading environment.  
 Analytics track   
 Analysts have an opportunity to directly influence the bottom line as part of a highly commercial and skilled team. Working in the fast-paced world of our trading business and with access to vast amounts of data and information, you’ll focus on rotations that are designed to build your skills and knowledge to drive continued growth in trading profits and acting as a subject matter expert on energy market fundamentals.  
 Requirements 
 To apply for this role, you must be taking a placement year/year in industry, due to graduate in 2029, and be on track for a 2:1.
 You are also expected to have strong spoken and written English language skills, including business and technical English.  Language skills will be assessed throughout the recruitment process.
 Please note: We value individuals who take initiative, are committed to excellence, and can adapt positively to change and challenges in a supportive environment. 
 Location 
 This role will be based out of the following UK office:
 Canary Wharf (bp , 25 North Colonnade, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5HZ)
 Start & end date 
 Monday 21st June 2027 to Friday 30th June 2028
 Please note: Our internships are full-time. If youwill struggle to be available for these dates &/or may not be able to work full time, please flag this if you are invited to a technical interview, or earlier if possible.
 Other information 
 Please note the following when applying:
 You can only apply to one bp early careers opportunity globally per academic year – within this time, we will only process the first application you make. You will be withdrawn from any subsequent applications. 
 We recruit on a rolling basis – this means roles may close once positions are filled or we have enough applications. If you’re interested in a role, we strongly recommend applying as soon as possible while applications remain open. Unless you apply to a role with a location explicitly stated, role locations are not guaranteed – where not stated, you will be placed in a location based on business need

8aabcb15a5d7.description:
Engineering That Stands Up to Anything 
 At BakerHicks, we design the structures that hold some of the UK’s most critical, complex and high-profile projects together. From aviation to power, defence to major infrastructure, our multidisciplinary teams deliver engineering that is safe, efficient and genuinely buildable.
 We’re looking for a Structural Engineer who’s detail-driven, technically sharp, and ready to make an impact across a diverse project portfolio. 
 This role is ideal for someone who is 1–2 years away from achieving chartership and looking to join a company that offers the support, exposure, and project experience needed to get them over the line and progress into a Senior-level position 
 What You’ll Do 
 You’ll play a key role in delivering high-quality structural engineering designs as part of an integrated project team. This includes:
 Producing detailed structural calculations and analysis to current British Standards and Eurocodes
 Developing designs for a wide range of buildings and structural elements
 Creating and checking sketches, drawings and technical deliverables to company and client quality standards
 Collaborating closely with architects, engineers and technicians across multiple disciplines
 Supporting and mentoring CAD technicians, trainees and graduates
 Managing and contributing to packages of work, with increasing responsibility as experience grows
 Participating in technical meetings and representing BakerHicks when required
 Promoting quality, accuracy and Perfect Delivery across every project
 What You Bring 
 You’re someone who thrives on technical accuracy, teamwork and good engineering judgement. You’ll bring:
 A Master’s degree in Structural or Civil Engineering (or a Bachelor’s with willingness to complete further learning)
 A strong understanding of Eurocodes, British Standards, CDM and UK technical standards
 Experience designing with steel, concrete, timber and/or masonry
 AutoCAD proficiency (2D/3D); Revit experience is a bonus
 Solid understanding of structural design principles and site-wide considerations such as earthworks
 Excellent communication skills - able to collaborate, influence and negotiate across disciplines
 Strong time management and the ability to juggle multiple tasks under pressure
 A full UK driving licence and eligibility for security/airside clearance
 Sector experience in Aviation, Defence, Custodial or Power is a plus!
 Who You Are 
 You’re methodical, practical and positive - someone who takes responsibility for their work, self-checks for accuracy, and always keeps the bigger picture in mind. You enjoy mentoring others, contributing to team knowledge, and maintaining high professional standards, including keeping up to date with ICE/IStructE development requirements and almost close to getting chartered and want the support that will get you there.
 Why BakerHicks? 
 You’ll be part of a business known for technical excellence and innovation. You’ll get real responsibility, support toward chartership, involvement in major engineering projects, and the opportunity to develop and grow within a collaborative, respected team.
 Ready to engineer something you’ll be proud of? 
 If you’re a Structural Engineer who wants varied work, a strong technical community and a chance to make your mark - we’d love to hear from you.
 Apply today to build the next chapter of your engineering career with BakerHicks.
 BakerHicks has been delivering excellence in engineering, design, and project delivery since 1957. With 14 offices across the UK and Europe, we offer you the chance to work on meaningful projects that enhance communities and contribute to sustainable growth.
 Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.
 The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. 
 In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations. 
 Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: ( National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK ) 
 About BakerHicks  
 We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks . 
 BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  
 Benefits  
 Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  
 What you get will depend on what you do, with individual performance-related rewards also on offer in addition to:

 Discount scheme (including gym membership, mobile phones etc) 
 Flexible/hybrid working 
 Family friendly policies 
 Employee assistance 
 Professional development 
 BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout. 
 BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.

d4b7378fdce1.description:
Ready to revolutionize healthcare, making it faster and more accessible than ever before? 
 How we started: 
 Founded in 2013 by Dwayne D’Souza, HeliosX   was built on a simple but powerful idea: healthcare should be easier to access, faster to receive, and centred around the individual. From day one, we’ve grown without external funding; scaling profitably through technology, disciplined execution, and deep medical expertise. What started as a challenger idea has become one of the most significant healthcare platforms operating globally today.
 Where we are now: 
 We’ve earned the trust of millions of people worldwide through category-leading products and well-known brands, including MedExpress, Dermatica, ZipHealth, RocketRX, and Levity. A key driver of our success is vertical integration; we operate our own manufacturing and proprietary products, led by in-house medical teams, researchers, and pharmacists at the top of their fields.
 In 2025, HeliosX treated more than 1.7 million patients globally and reached £781m in revenue, representing +337% year-on-year growth and cementing our position as the clear market leader in the UK. That growth translates into real-world outcomes: our weight-loss treatments helped patients lose 8.5 million kilograms of excess weight in 2025 alone, contributing to an estimated 1,300 fewer cardiac events. This is growth with measurable, life-changing impact at scale.
 Today, we operate across four international markets, with successful launches in Germany and Canada and continued expansion in the US. We were also recently recognised in the Sunday Times Top 100 fastest-growing tech companies, further validation of both our momentum and our ambition.
 Where we’re going: 
 2026 is another significant year for HeliosX. Our ambition is to surpass £1.1bn in revenue, continue expanding thoughtfully into new international markets and broaden our condition and treatment portfolio. As we scale, we're focused on building the technology, operational excellence and clinical capabilities that will support sustainable long-term growth. Joining HeliosX now means helping shape the systems, teams and products that will define the next chapter of digital healthcare. You'll be solving complex problems at pace, working alongside exceptional people and building products that genuinely improve lives at scale.
 There’s never been a more exciting time to join HeliosX. Come be a part of making our dream of easier and faster healthcare a reality! 
 The Opportunity 
 This opportunity is for a hands-on CRM marketer who can own the email production process from brief to send in Braze within probation, then grow into owning campaign strategy, testing and quarterly roadmap items using data to drive retention.
 What you’ll do 
 Delivery & Execution 
 Owns the end to end delivery of cross-channel CRM campaigns from ideation, planning, creative briefing to production and post-campaign analysis
 Manage the integration of Braze with other marketing technologies (e.g., Typeform) to drive data-enriched personalisation and improve customer engagement/retention across channels
 Leads the implementation of strategic CRM initiatives that leverage data analytics and automation to drive customer engagement and retention.
 Optimises CRM processes by analysing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing solutions that enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
 Responsible for developing and implementing best practices in CRM execution to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with organisational goals.
 Designs and conducts meaningful experiments aimed at influencing lag metrics (e.g., customer retention rates, LTV) by utilising A/B testing and other analytical methods.
 Strategy and Insights 
 Conducts data analysis to derive actionable insights that inform CRM  strategies to improve customer experience and achieve business goals
 Leads the creation of CRM initiatives to solve strategic problems, using internal insights and external research to inform our approach and deliver a best-in-class customer experience
 Develops complex customer journey maps that identify key touchpoints, pain points, and opportunities for enhancing customer experience.
 Applies market, industry and competitor insights to drive informed decision-making
 Creates and executes comprehensive cross-channel CRM strategies that integrate customer interactions across multiple platforms/channels to enhance customer engagement and drive business outcomes.
 Sets KPIs and success metrics tailored to CRM objectives and conducts thorough performance analysis to assess effectiveness, identify trends, and inform strategic adjustments.
 Support the wider CRM team to deliver monthly revenue targets and channel KPIs, remaining reactive and agile with a test-and-learn approach
 What you’ll bring to HeliosX 
 Experience in CRM within a D2C or subscription business.
 Hands-on HTML and Liquid coding experience.
 Experience building automated, multi-touch, omnichannel CRM journeys.
 Strong understanding of customer segmentation, data and CRM/retention metrics.
 Experience in the North American Market 
 Excellent prioritisation and project management skills in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate cross-functionally.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Creative problem-solving skills and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
 Able to work autonomously while contributing effectively to a team.
 Experience in Braze is desirable but not a deal breaker.
 Life at HeliosX 
At HeliosX, we want to improve healthcare for everyone, and to do this we need a team of brilliant people who share that ambition. We are currently a diverse team of engineers, scientists, clinical researchers, physicians, pharmacists, marketeers, and customer care specialists committed to our mission - but we need more talented folks to join us if we want to achieve our global ambitions!
Aside from working with our all-star team, here are some of the other benefits you may be eligible for coming on board: 
 Generous equity allocations with significant upside potential
 Annual leave allowance alongside public holidays
 Private health insurance, along with pre-existing condition, dental, and eye care cover
 Pension scheme
 Enhanced parental leave
 Cycle-to-work scheme
 Electric car scheme
 Free Dermatica and MedExpress products every month, as well as family discounts
 Annual home working and L&D allowance
 Free Headspace subscription, employee assistance programme, and discounted gym memberships

47278d6d40ac.description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.



Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.



We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.



With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.




THE ROLE

Our Business Analytics team is growing! We’re looking for a Graduate / Junior Business Analyst to join our team in London.

In this role you will help turn our Rewards and Core data into clear, trusted answers, building reporting and analysis that the business actually makes decisions on, and learning to do it AI-natively from day one.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Pull, shape and interrogate data with SQL to answer questions from across the teams

 - Build and evolve reporting and dashboards that people rely on, keeping them accurate and easy to read

 - Turn raw numbers into clear findings, and explain them simply to people who are not analysts

 - Use AI tools to work faster and smarter, from writing queries and creating dashboards to summarising results

 - Take on analysis independently as you grow, owning pieces of work end to end




ABOUT YOU

 - Strong analytical and numerical reasoning, you enjoy getting to the answer behind the numbers

 - Some hands-on exposure to SQL, or a fast learner keen to become fluent quickly

 - Confident in spreadsheets and at least one BI tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI

 - Genuinely AI-native and curious, you reach for AI tools to move faster and keep learning - experienced in AI (LLM) tools

 - You explain your thinking clearly, in writing and out loud

 - You thrive when working as part of a team

 - Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

 - Have excellent written and verbal English skills

 - Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!



What You’ll Get

 - Private Health Care (Bupa)

 - Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

 - Travel Insurance

 - Competitive Base Salary

 - Company Bonus Scheme

 - Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

 - Market-Leading Training Programme

 - Recognition & Reward Scheme

 - Annual Company Conference 

 - Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

 - Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks
   
   

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

If you like the sound of what we're all about at Quantum and want to join a team where you can make an impact, please apply or contact us at careers@quantum.media.
