db8fc7702add.title: Pensions Consultant
db8fc7702add.description:
We are seeking someone with strong communication and analytical skills to join Launchpad, the newest team at Octopus Money working on new financial services products. As our first dedicated client-facing hire, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring one of our exciting new products is delivered exceptionally: our pension splitting work with  amicable , another company in Octopus Group. In this capacity, you will own pension-related work within divorce cases and act as the primary point of contact throughout the lifecycle of each case. You will produce Pension on Divorce Expert reports using our pension calculation tools, while ensuring clients feel supported, informed, and confident during what is often a complex and sensitive period. 
 The role is not actuarial and does not involve expert witness work.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Client Relationship Management 
 Act as the primary point of contact for clients and build strong, trusted and ongoing relationships with them
 Communicate potentially complex financial information in a clear, calm, and accessible way.
 Provide reassurance and guidance to clients dealing with sensitive financial and personal circumstances.
 Manage expectations proactively, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage.
 Technical Pensions Work 
 Oversee and/or review pension sharing calculations and related outputs.
 Interpret pension benefits across Defined Benefit (DB), Defined Contribution (DC), and hybrid arrangements.
 Work with Cash Equivalent Transfer Values (CETVs) and scheme-specific benefit structures.
 Ensure accuracy and consistency of all technical calculations and supporting documentation.
 Apply pension knowledge in a practical, case-focused manner.
 Case & Workflow Management 
 Manage a portfolio of client cases end-to-end.
 Prioritise workload effectively to meet deadlines and client expectations.
 Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of outputs.
 Maintain clear case records and ensure high standards of documentation.
 Professional Liaison & Collaboration 
 Work closely with solicitors, financial advisers, and other professionals 
 Contribute to a collaborative, service-led approach across all client interactions.
 Support continuous improvement of internal processes, templates, and client experience.
 What we’re looking for 
 We’re looking for someone with previous experience or qualifications in the pensions space. This can include any combination of the following: 
 Relevant experience in financial planning, paraplanning, pensions administration, consultancy, or a technical pensions role.
 Experience working with different types of pension schemes.
 Relevant pensions qualification and experience (e.g. PMI, DipPFS)
 Knowledge of UK pension schemes, including DB and DC arrangements.
 In addition, we’re looking for someone who is:  
 Able to build strong, trust-based client relationships
 Calm, confident, and professional in client-facing situations.
 A strong communicator with the ability to simplify complex technical topics.
 Empathetic and sensitive to clients navigating difficult personal circumstances.
 Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
 Obsessed about providing great customer outcomes.
 Proactive in identifying risks, developing solutions and resolving issues early.
 Effective and structured when prioritising work and managing workflow.
 Why Join Us 
 This role is an exciting opportunity to to work in new and unique areas of financial services, across the Octopus Group
 You’ll have direct ownership of client relationships and case outcomes.
 We offer a supportive and collaborative working environment that spans Octopus Money and amicable, as well as the broader Octopus Group
 You’ll get exposure to complex, varied, and meaningful casework.
 You’ll grow and contribute to a brand new collaborative product between Octopus and amicable
 As the first hire for this new product, you’ll be exposed to career development opportunities in the specialist and growing area of pensions and divorce.
 Base Salary
 In return for your contribution we offer a base salary of £45,000 - £55,000 DOE + benefits 
 We want people to grow here, to feel supported and to feel proud of the impact they make!
 You’ll get:
 Hybrid working with 3 days in the office each week (Tuesday - Thursday)
 18 days a year working from anywhere 
 Performance-based bonus
 The opportunity to participate in our Share Incentive Plan (HMRC approved scheme enabling employees to invest tax efficiently)
 Company pension
 Private medical insurance
 Enhanced parental leave and Return to Work coaching (find out more on our website)
 Birthday day off
 A mission driven focus - the chance to help people improve their lives through financial wellbeing, and a supportive team who care about what they do
 About Octopus Group  
 We're part of Octopus Group, a privately-owned business that's spent 25 years doing things differently. Octopus Group builds businesses designed to outlast it, aiming to leave things a little better for the generations that follow.
 That same instinct runs through the whole group:
 Octopus Energy changed how millions of people think about their energy provider, built on fairness, transparency and a genuinely good customer experience
 Octopus Legacy is changing how people plan for the end of life
 amicable is building a better way to go through divorce
 Aurora is rethinking education
 Seccl is building the fintech infrastructure behind modern investing
 Octopus Investments and Octopus Capital back the ideas and businesses of tomorrow
 We share that same DNA, doing the same thing in a different corner of people's lives: money.
 Octopus Group doesn't just talk about entrepreneurship, the group enables it. Springboard, a program open to anyone however junior or senior, lets people pitch an idea to win funding. A number of businesses have been started this way, founded by former Octopus employees.
 Please note, as a regulated business we are required to run background checks for all employees which covers adverse financial and unspent convictions. These will only take place upon a successful job offer.
 We believe in equal financial education for everybody, no matter their background. The same goes for opportunities within our team. We pride ourselves on building an inclusive working environment where diversity is celebrated.

8552747f2f2e.title: Junior Legal Counsel
8552747f2f2e.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a small but ambitious Legal team with a broad remit, working with every part of the business — from Product and Engineering to Credit Risk, Marketing and People. Lendable is an FCA-regulated lender operating in the UK, US and Mexico, so you'll get early exposure to regulated products and new markets. As Lendable grows, this role is focused on commercial contracts, product and corporate work. You'll own matters end to end, explain legal issues clearly to non-lawyers, and weigh the legal position against what the business is trying to achieve.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements. You'll lead on supplier and customer contracts, engagement letters and NDAs, and support on partnership and other strategic contracts as you build towards leading them

 - Manage our contract review process, including triaging incoming requests, providing templates and reviews, and managing the e-signature process (for example DocuSign) through to completion

 - Respond to day-to-day legal queries from the business and our counterparties

 - Drive process and knowledge management by building and maintaining document repositories, administering our contract management and AI tooling and helping us develop processes to support contract review and negotiation

 - Support on intellectual property matters and litigious matters as they arise

 - Take on company secretarial and governance work

 - Support corporate and transactional work, including KYC / due diligence requests and diligence reviews on corporate projects

 - Work closely with the rest of the Legal team to deliver timely, first-class legal support




HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - You'll help drive the business forward by taking the initiative and embracing work beyond your comfort zone

 - You'll get to grips with new markets and financial products, bringing energy and curiosity to each new challenge



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - NQ - 2PQE, qualified in England & Wales, or in another common law jurisdiction with relevant UK experience

 - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including explaining legal issues to non-lawyers

 - Strong organisation: you can run multiple matters at once and prioritise them independently

 - Comfortable with pace and change, and keen to take ownership of a broad remit rather than a narrow specialism






LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

2981d0ea1d1c.title: Junior Commerce Project Manager
2981d0ea1d1c.description:
Junior Commerce Project Manager, Commerce 
Location: MMM Headquarters, High Street Kensington, London 
Workplace Type: Permanent  
 About the Role 
Mail Metro Media has been going through an exciting stage of development with its Commerce proposition, working with some of the UKs most well known brands. Now we are seeking a dynamic, organised and analytical Junior Commerce Project Manager to join the team. This role requires an understanding of digital publishing, affiliate marketing, and performance-based advertising models, such as CPA and CPC. You will have full accountability for the end-to-end delivery of our Commerce campaigns ranging from single activations to long term 360 partnership activations with responsibilities including, but not limited to:
 Campaign Preparation & Planning
 Agree and manage campaign timelines with clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring key deadlines are clearly communicated and met.
 Request and collate all campaign assets, including briefing forms, copy, links (including creation of tracked links), product information and imagery.
 Ensure campaigns are booked on to internals systems (i.e Adpoint and Squirrel) to ensure correct activity is tracked and billed.
 Maintain client folders ensuring all documentation and assets are saved down.
 Coordinate any sign off internally or externally to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time within the agreed parameters.
 Reporting & Reconciliation
 Monitor campaign delivery throughout, ensuring agreed KPIs are pacing as expected. Proactively escalating to appropriate team members where this isn’t the case.
 Work closely with internal stakeholders, including our partnerships teams, to report back on campaign performances and delivery plans.
 Complete post-campaign reporting and ensure campaign activity is fully closed down when finished.
 Support the creation of case studies where appropriate, identifying strong performance stories, client results and useful campaign learnings.
 Support with month end finance reconciliation to ensure all campaigns are billed in a timely manner.
 Growth & Best Practices
 Develop a strong understanding of the Mail Metro Media Commerce proposition, products, audiences and commercial model.
 Demonstrate commercial awareness and an understanding of what makes a successful Commerce campaign.
 Build strong relationships with internal teams and, where appropriate, clients and external partners
 Support the wider Commerce team in developing and implementing more efficient ways of working and best practices
 Person Specification 
 Personable, self-motivated and detail driven, committed to quality with a high standard of accuracy.
 Proactive and resourceful, with a natural instinct to identify problems and find solutions before they become issues.
 Analytical, with the ability to interpret campaign performance, identify trends and understand where optimisation may be required.
 Understanding of the UK digital media landscape and the role Commerce plays across websites and social media platforms.
 Familiarity with affiliate networks, tracking platforms, and digital advertising tools a plus.
 Package Description 
 Our benefits package increases the longer you’ve been with us. Here’s what to expect:
 25 days’ holiday (increasing by 1 per year up to a total of 30)
 Pension plan and life cover
 Discounts on online shopping, dining cards and vouchers, and access to our Employee Assistance Programme
 Onsite gym, subsidised canteen and onsite nurse and GP clinics
 Plus much more...
 About Mail Metro Media 
Mail Metro Media is the advertising home of some of the UK’s most engaged newsbrands: Daily Mail, The Mail on Sunday, MailOnline, Metro, The i Paper and New Scientist. The Mail Metro team provides a single point of contact across print, digital, audio, video and social, allowing agencies and advertisers easy access to the millions of consumers who engage with dmg media’s brands every day.
www.mailmetromedia.co.uk
 Leadership 
At the helm of Mail Metro Media are Chief Executive Officer, Dom Williams, who is responsible for all advertising revenue across our far-reaching portfolio and development Ryan Uhl is our Managing Director of Commerce, with over 20 years with the business, provides a wealth of industry experience and oversees the growth of Commerce. 
 Why work for Mail Metro Media? 
Not only will you be a part of the biggest media organisation in the UK, but you’ll work somewhere that’s dedicated to people and culture. Our people are a top priority - whether that’s supporting mental health, being Disability Confident, accommodating parenthood, providing fitness classes, driving diversity and inclusion, flexibility, or anything else, it matters to us.
Many of our team members work flexibly, in many different ways, including flexible hours or an element of working from home. Please talk to us during your interview about any flexibility you may need - we can usually find a way to make work work for you!
Here are some of the top reasons our people love working for us:
 Collaborate and innovate with the best people in media on a daily basis
 Work in an award-winning team in the fast-paced world of news and entertainment
 Get support in reaching your professional goals through webinars, workshops, mentorship and more
 Get personal support through mental wellbeing, volunteering time off, our menopause policies, a working parents group, our EDI Champions network, and more
 Comprehensive benefits including medical and dental insurance, childcare schemes, a huge range of discounts, enhanced pension contributions and more
 A lively, friendly office complete with a free gym, subsidised canteen and doctor’s surgery (London only)
 Our Commitment 
 We are committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability.
 We are Disability Confident Committed. Please let us know if you require any recruitment documentation in other formats or if you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process. Please be assured that any such information will be held separately to your recruitment application and will not be considered as part of the selection process.

 Intellectual curiosity and proactive approach to searching for new and creative ideas.

 Interest in business.

09dfc507dc68.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. 
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 


As a Junior Data Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Kpler’s global commodity market data, with a primary focus on Oil Market Data. Working cross-functionally across business units, you will monitor data health metrics, identify system anomalies, and build actionable dashboards that empower decision-makers. In this role, you will also help pioneer internal workflow automation by experimenting with modern AI-driven tools to streamline data validation and analysis
 We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
 
We build together
We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
 
We are here to help
We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
 
 
Our People Pledge
 
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.
 
 
 
By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the Staff Privacy Notice

614e937f218b.title: Junior Social Content Creator
614e937f218b.description:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021. 
 JOB PURPOSE 
 If you live and breathe TikTok, META, YouTube and internet culture, love making content and want to turn that instinct into brilliant creative work for some of the world’s biggest brands, we want to hear from you.
 This is a hands-on role where you’ll help concept, film and edit social-first content that connects with audiences, taps into culture and helps our clients stand out. Working alongside experienced creatives, you’ll bring ideas to life across platforms including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, primarily for organic social, with opportunities to support paid social creative.
 You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. You’ll be supported by a wider team across Creative, Strategy, Community, Account and Media, giving you the opportunity to develop your ideas, craft and understanding of what makes effective social content.
 Regularly appearing on camera is an expected part of this role. Your image, voice and likeness will feature in content created for clients’ organic social channels. Content featuring you may also be considered for paid media, subject to appropriate usage terms, approvals and DEPT® policies.
 No two days will look the same. You might be filming on location, hitting the streets for a mini-mic shoot, creating something reactive from the office or supporting a larger production. Location shoots and travel are a genuine part of the role, so you’ll need to be comfortable working in different environments and travelling where required.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Create social-first content: Contribute to concepting, filming and editing engaging content for your clients, with support and creative direction from senior team members. Bring ideas and cultural insight: Stay close to trends, creators, conversations and emerging platform behaviours, sharing relevant opportunities and your own creative perspective with the team. Appear on camera: Regularly feature in the content you help create, bringing ideas to life through presenting, participating in formats and other on-camera activity.
Produce planned and reactive content: Help deliver timely, platform-native work, with support on prioritisation, balancing speed with craft and brand consistency. Support content shoots: Help prepare for and deliver content capture, contributing to shot lists, props and practical preparation, and supporting filming on location. Develop your editing and storytelling: Use in-platform and third-party tools to explore different hooks, formats, editing styles and storytelling techniques. Adapt content for different audiences: Learn how to apply each client’s tone of voice and tailor ideas to different platforms, communities and objectives. Support paid social creative: Work with the wider team to develop and adapt content for paid campaigns, exploring different hooks, formats and creative variations. Learn from performance: Work with Social and Media colleagues to understand what resonates with audiences and apply those learnings to future ideas and iterations.
Spot community-led opportunities: Identify interesting comments, conversations and community behaviours, suggesting creative responses or content opportunities for Community Managers to activate. Collaborate and develop: Work closely with Creative, Strategy, Community, Account and Media colleagues, apply feedback constructively and build confidence sharing your thinking in internal and client conversations. 
 Publishing, channel management, community management and moderation are not responsibilities of this role. 
 SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 A genuine passion for social media, content creation and internet culture, with good knowledge of TikTok, Instagram and the wider social landscape. A strong instinct for what makes content entertaining, engaging, shareable and native to the platform. Some hands-on experience filming and editing social content, whether professionally, personally, through education or independent projects. Experience using in-app editing features and/or tools such as CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro, with an appetite to develop your skills further. Confidence and willingness to appear regularly on camera as part of your role. A proactive, hands-on approach, with enthusiasm for contributing ideas and bringing them to life with support. Openness to feedback and creative direction, and a willingness to experiment, learn and improve. A collaborative, adaptable approach and the ability to communicate clearly with colleagues. Comfortable travelling and working on location for shoots when required. A portfolio or examples of social content that demonstrate your creative thinking and making skills. Work from personal channels, education and independent projects is welcome. 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience creating content for brands, agencies or commercial social accounts. An interest in how creative approaches differ between organic and paid social. Photography, graphic design or other creative production skills. An interest in travel, lifestyle and consumer brands. 
 CREATOR WELFARE AND USAGE 
 As regularly appearing in public-facing brand content is part of this role, DEPT® recognises its responsibility to support the wellbeing of employees featured in that content. Clear processes will be in place to manage and escalate abusive, discriminatory, harassing or otherwise inappropriate audience responses directed at employees. You will have a clear route to raise concerns and access support, without being expected to moderate or manage those responses yourself. Any use of your image, voice or likeness in paid media will be subject to appropriate usage terms, approvals and DEPT® policies. 
 WE OFFER 
 A flexible, hybrid working policy
 The choice of medical healthcare providers (Bupa or Medicash) 
 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and your birthday off each year
 Company pension scheme 
 EAP scheme
 Ride to work scheme 
 Enhanced family friendly policies
 Buddy Program: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
 A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
 Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
 The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
 Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.
 WHT DEPT? 
 We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.
 We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.
 At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.
 DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION  
 At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive

aa39bd0ec0e0.title: Engineer - Building Physics
aa39bd0ec0e0.location: London; Manchester; Warwick London, Manchester, Warwick
aa39bd0ec0e0.description:
Why this role? 
 As an  Engineer – Building Physics , you'll play a key role in helping to design buildings that are energy-efficient, comfortable, and sustainable. Working as part of our growing Building Physics team, you'll collaborate closely with Mechanical Engineers and the wider design team to understand how buildings perform and use that insight to shape better design solutions.
 From thermal and energy modelling to airflow and overheating assessments, you'll use specialist software to support projects across a range of sectors. You'll also have the opportunity to work directly with clients, contribute to project delivery, and help develop the next generation of engineers through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
 At BakerHicks, you'll be part of a supportive, multi-disciplinary team where you'll be encouraged to develop your skills, broaden your experience, and take ownership of your work.
 About You 
 You are passionate about building performance, sustainability, and using data to support smarter design decisions. You enjoy solving technical challenges, working collaboratively, and communicating complex information in a way that is easy to understand.
 You will:
 Have experience delivering thermal and energy modelling for building projects
 Be working towards Chartered status with CIBSE
 Enjoy collaborating with engineers, architects, and other design professionals
 Be confident presenting findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences
 Have experience mentoring junior engineers or be keen to support early career development
 Take pride in delivering high-quality, accurate work
 Key Purpose 
 Develop thermal, energy and CFD models using architectural and engineering information in accordance with current guidance, standards, regulations and project deliverables.
 Liaise with Mechanical Engineers and the wider design team to establish appropriate modelling inputs, interpret results and inform design decisions.
 Contribute to the development and mentoring of Early Careers population and the continuous improvement of departmental capabilities.
 Champion quality and compliance controls within local teams and projects.
 Responsibilities 
 Provide Building Physics engineering services on behalf of BakerHicks under the direction of the line manager or project lead.
 Produce thermal, energy and CFD models and associated deliverables, including calculations, technical reports and concise presentation of findings.
 Liaise directly with clients and members of the design and construction teams to obtain modelling inputs, agree appropriate strategies and communicate findings and recommendations.
 Plan and monitor Building Physics tasks and deliverables against the agreed project brief, programme and scope, raising changes or risks as appropriate.
 Check own work and, where required, review calculations, models and technical deliverables produced by others to ensure they meet project requirements, quality standards and applicable compliance criteria.
 Collaborate closely with multi-disciplinary members of the design team to deliver informative and accurate modelling results.
 Contribute to the preparation of enquiry plans, tender reviews, fee estimate sheets, scopes of work and change controls as required.
 Accountabilities 
 Ensure own work is compliant with company quality management procedures and recognised industry best practice.
 Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications 
 Essential 
 Membership of Chartered Institute of Building Services Engineers (CIBSE), working towards Chartered Member status.
 Demonstrable experience of delivering Thermal and Energy models in at least one sector that BakerHicks operates in.
 Confident communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly.
 Ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders that deliver long-term benefits.
 Experience of producing clear technical reports and providing evidence-based recommendations to support design development.
 Experience of managing Building Physics tasks and deliverables against agreed project programmes and scopes.
 Essential technical experience: thermal and energy modelling, including heating loads, cooling loads, natural ventilation, overheating assessments, Part L and Section 6 assessments.
 Experience in using the following specialist software or similar:
 IES VE
 TAS
 Design Builder
 Desirable 
 Experience in delivering modelling services in several sectors that BakerHicks operates in.
 Experience of contributing to bids, proposals, and tender specifications.
 Understanding of commercial elements of projects.
 Experience in using the following specialist software or similar:
 Autodesk CFD
 Autodesk Revit
 Autodesk AutoCAD
 Autodesk Navisworks
 Awareness of sustainability assessment and net-zero design approaches relevant to building performance analysis.

25c53584405f.title: L1 Technical Support Specialist (SMB)
25c53584405f.description:
Who we are: 
 For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world’s most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.
 Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It’s a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.
 We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.
 Your role: 
 We are seeking a highly motivated, client-focused Junior Technical Support Specialist to support our Small and Medium Business (SMB) team as part of the Technical Support team. This role is focused on being the first point of contact for our customers, providing foundational support to ensure our services run correctly and smoothly. This role is part of our 24x7 Frontline team, responsible for triaging of tickets, assisting customers with user management and contact management, basic troubleshooting and initial support for Global Relay services. Junior Technical Support Specialists will learn to use Creative problem-solving to understand customer issues, gather necessary information and resolve entry-level Technical problems. They will effectively communicate both verbally and in writing in a fast-paced environment, working to escalate more complex issues to Intermediate and Senior Specialists while handling initial user requests and administrative tasks. This role balances entry level technical troubleshooting capability with an understanding of client business impact, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and professionally.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Be the first point of contact for customers, providing first level technical support for all Global Relay Services.
 Assist customers' basic technical issues and end user queries.
 Collect pertinent issue details and create clear, detailed escalation tickets for Intermediate Technical Support Specialists to investigate and resolve.
 Perform user management requests, self-service requests and simple script import requests.
 Manage support case queues and case triage to appropriate resources.
 Manage our customers' authorized contact changes through identity verification and online research to verify ensure records are accurate.
 Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
 Handle overflow calls from admins where required.
 About you: 
 You are technically strong, operationally disciplined, and comfortable working within a structured support model. You understand the importance of balancing responsiveness with scalability and process adherence. You thrive in collaborative environments and are comfortable working alone as well as part of a team.
 Requirements: 
 Minimum 1-2 Years in a customer facing technical support role.
 Strong desire to learn and develop technical troubleshooting skills
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured, SLA-driven environment.
 Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow defined policies and procedures.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Your Technical Skills:

5281eba936c3.title: Customer Success Executive B2B
5281eba936c3.description:
This is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing, mission-led business that's transforming how people access financial advice. We partner with HR and Reward teams to bring financial wellbeing into the workplace. As Customer Success Executive, you'll own a portfolio of employer clients end to end - from onboarding through to renewal - and be the trusted partner for their HR and Reward leads.
 You'll work closely with our Customer Success Lead, but you'll run your accounts with real autonomy: setting the plan, spotting risk early, growing engagement and making sure every client renews because they can see the value. You'll be surrounded by a team that moves fast, thinks sharply, and cares deeply about the mission.
 About Octopus Money 
 At Octopus Money, we're on a mission to make money advice accessible to all, because the right advice can turn your life dreams into reality.
 The facts are alarming: half of Brits reach retirement age without enough money to live the life they want, financial stress is a leading cause of poor mental health and only 8% of us have access to 1-to-1 advice.
 There's plenty of information out there, but most of us just wish that someone we trust would tell us what to do with our money.
 With Octopus Money, you get a personalised plan and a friendly expert to help you make it happen. We combine advisers, coaches and technology to understand your situation and recommend the right steps for your savings, investments, pensions and more.
 To transform millions of lives, we need a movement. So whether you're a workplace supporting your employees' financial health or a firm that wants to offer affordable advice to your customers, we hope you'll join us.
 We believe everyone deserves personal, 1-to-1 advice with their money.
 The role and opportunity 
 You'll own a book of SMB to mid-market employer clients, working directly with HR and Reward leaders at top UK workplaces. You'll guide new clients through onboarding, then take full responsibility for the health, engagement and retention of each account as the benefit rolls out to their colleagues. You'll also support the Customer Success Lead on our enterprise accounts, giving you exposure to our largest and most complex clients. 
 We believe curious problem-solvers who obsess over customer outcomes deserve to grow into future stars here. You'll report to the Customer Success Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing and Product across the wider Commercial team. You'll thrive if you take ownership, make decisions with confidence and help shape how we run Customer Success as we scale.
 Day to day you will 
 Own a portfolio of SMB to mid-market employer clients end to end, acting as their main point of contact from launch through to renewal
 Support the Customer Success Lead on our enterprise accounts, helping with onboarding, campaigns, reporting and day-to-day relationship management for our largest clients
 Lead onboarding for new clients, setting clear timelines and success measures so every rollout lands smoothly
 Build account plans with HR and Reward stakeholders, agreeing goals and reviewing progress at regular check-ins and business reviews
 Drive retention and renewals by tracking account health, spotting risk early and acting on it before it becomes a problem
 Find opportunities to grow accounts, such as extending the benefit to more employees, unlock different funding models or additional revenue
 Design and run engaging campaigns with HR contacts to get employees excited about the benefit and lift take-up
 Own the reporting for your accounts: track key customer success metrics and turn the data into clear insight on the impact for each workforce
 Take ownership of escalations and complaints, resolving them quickly and fairly, and involving the right internal teams where needed
 Share what you're hearing from clients with Product and the wider team, and help improve our Customer Success playbooks and processes as we scale
 About you 
 A genuine desire to help people. We're a mission-driven business, so it's important that you can show a passion for helping people improve their lives.
 Commercially minded account owner. You treat your accounts like your own. You know what makes a client renew, you notice when something's off, and you act before you're asked.
 Customer obsession. You get obsessed with solving problems for your customers and keep going until you've found a solution you're happy with.
 Build relationships that stick. You earn trust with senior stakeholders through credibility, insight, and always having their best interest at heart - and you're comfortable having a challenging conversation when it's the right thing for the client.
 Knowledge and skills required 
 1-2 years' experience in an account management or customer success role, owning your own book of B2B accounts
 A track record of retaining and growing accounts, with experience of renewals or expansion conversations
 Confidence building relationships with senior stakeholders and running structured check-ins or business reviews
 Experience managing multiple accounts and projects at once, balancing competing priorities without dropping the ball
 Confident analysing and interpreting data using Excel / Google Sheets to track account health and performance and inform decisions
 Hands-on experience with a CRM or CS tool (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Intercom)
 A challenger mindset you're not afraid to question assumptions, bring fresh ideas, and push for the best outcome for the client and the business
 A passion for making the world of personal finance more accessible to everyone
 Experience in HR tech, employee benefits or financial services is a bonus, but not essential
 What you'll get 
 Starting salary of £38,000–£45,000 depending on experience. 
 We want people to grow here, to feel supported and to feel proud of the impact they make!
 You’ll get:
 Hybrid working with 3 days in the office each week (Tuesday - Thursday)
 18 days a year working from anywhere 
 Performance-based bonus
 The opportunity to participate in our Share Incentive Plan (HMRC approved scheme enabling employees to invest tax efficiently)
 Company pension
 Private medical insurance
 Enhanced parental leave and Return to Work coaching (find out more on our website)
 Birthday day off
 A mission driven focus - the chance to help people improve their lives through financial wellbeing, and a supportive team who care about what they do
 About Octopus Group  
 We're part of Octopus Group, a privately-owned business that's spent 25 years doing things differently. Octopus Group builds businesses designed to outlast it, aiming to leave things a little better for the generations that follow.
 That same instinct runs through the whole group:
 Octopus Energy changed how millions of people think about their energy provider, built on fairness, transparency and a genuinely good customer experience
 Octopus Legacy is changing how people plan for the end of life
 amicable is building a better way to go through divorce
 Aurora is rethinking education
 Seccl is building the fintech infrastructure behind modern investing
 Octopus Investments and Octopus Capital back the ideas and businesses of tomorrow
 We share that same DNA, doing the same thing in a different corner of people's lives: money.
 Octopus Group doesn't just talk about entrepreneurship, the group enables it. Springboard, a program open to anyone however junior or senior, lets people pitch an idea to win funding. A number of businesses have been started this way, founded by former Octopus employees.
 Please note, as a regulated business we are required to run background checks for all employees which covers adverse financial and unspent convictions. These will only take place upon a successful job offer.

120ff28d8fb7.title: Internship: Expression of Interest
120ff28d8fb7.location: London; Madrid; New York; Rome London, Madrid, New York, Rome
120ff28d8fb7.description:
About Us 
 Fideres delivers effective economic analysis and testimony, turning data into courtroom advantage. As global litigation experts, we help law firms secure new cases and offer unbiased, conflict-free insights for complex and innovative disputes. Driven by rigorous analysis, we empower justice—for all—from case strategy to victory.
 By dedicating ourselves solely to litigation-based economic analysis, we can provide truly unbiased assessments and maintain our commitment to objectivity.
 We operate across the US, UK, and EU, through four fully staffed offices with a team of around 70 professionals.
 The Internship 
 Fideres takes on interns throughout the year, whenever our teams and cases need extra support. Rather than run a single recruitment round, we accept expressions of interest all year round and keep a pool of strong candidates on file. When a place opens that suits your skills, interests, and availability, we will contact you directly.
 Who we are looking for 
 We are looking for people who are interested in how markets work, and who care what happens when they don’t work fairly. You do not need to have studied economics, and you do not need prior consulting experience.
 You are likely to fit well if you:
 Are studying for, or have recently completed, a degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, law, or a related subject.
 Are comfortable working with numbers, and with Excel at a minimum.
 Experience with Python, R, Stata, or SQL is welcome but not required.
 Work Eligibility Requirements 
 All applicants must have the right to work in the location/s selected in their application form. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas for internship positions at this time.
 Why Fideres 
 Fideres’s vision is to become the leading litigation-only economic consulting firm, free of corporate conflicts.
 Following years of growth, over the past two years Fideres has started to expand internationally and we now have offices established in London, New York, Rome and Madrid. We plan to open an office in Australia and to grow our presence in Germany.
 We are looking for candidates, who are committed to Fideres’s strategy and values, and who are willing to grow in this phase of our company’s expansion.
 How to register your interest 
 Please send us your CV via the application form below. Cover letters are optional but encouraged, as they help us understand why you're interested in an internship with Fideres.
 We screen every submission. After that initial screening, we will let you know whether we are holding your application on file. When a place opens, we contact the candidates on file whose profile fits.
 We keep your details on file for 12 months, then delete them. If no suitable place opens in that time, you are welcome to register again.
 E-Verify Participation Notice for U.S. Applicants Only 
 After you accept an offer of employment and complete Form I-9, we will use E-Verify to confirm your eligibility to work in the United States. E-Verify is never used to pre-screen candidates or as a factor in hiring decisions. All U.S. applicants should review the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters, which can be found on our Careers page at E-Verify Participation - Fideres 
 Questions
 If you have any questions about our process, please contact us at careers@fideres.com.
 Please review our privacy policy here.
